description: Returns a snapshot of the current macOS system state: battery level, charging state, and power source (AC/Battery/UPS), Wi-Fi association and network name, hostname, macOS version, uptime in seconds, and connected display count. All fields reflect live system state at the time of the call. A field whose probe fails is null and named in `unavailable`, never filled with a guess. macOS withholds the Wi-Fi network name from an app without Location Services access; a connected Mac then reports `connected: true` with `ssid: null`.
name: macos_get_info

charging.description: True while charge is flowing into the battery (pmset reports "charging" or "finishing charge"). False when it reports "charged", "AC attached; not charging" (held at a charge limit or paused), or "discharging".

level.description: Battery charge level as a percentage (0–100).

power_source.description: What the Mac is drawing power from, per pmset.

battery.description: Battery state. null on a Mac that reports no battery, and null when the power probe failed; only the second case lists `battery` in `unavailable`.

display_count.description: Number of connected displays; 0 on a headless Mac. null when its probe failed (`unavailable` lists `display_count`).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

macos_version.description: macOS product version, e.g. "15.1". null when its probe failed (`unavailable` lists `macos_version`).

unavailable.description: Fields whose probe failed or printed output that could not be read; each one named is null. Empty when every probe succeeded.

uptime_seconds.description: Whole seconds since the last boot.

connected.description: True when the Wi-Fi device's link is active, i.e. it is associated with a network. False when it is not, or when the Mac has no Wi-Fi hardware port.

ssid.description: Name of the joined network. null when not connected. null while connected means macOS withheld the name: reading it requires Location Services access for the app hosting this server. When `unavailable` lists `wifi.ssid`, the name probe failed instead.

wifi.description: Wi-Fi association. null when its probe failed (`unavailable` lists `wifi`).

title: Get macOS System Info
